# incident_status_page (Data Source)

Look up a status page, either by `id` or by `name`. Set exactly one of the two lookup attributes; setting both, or neither, is rejected at plan time.

Status pages are created in the incident.io dashboard rather than through the API, so there is no `incident_status_page` resource. Use this data source to reference one from configuration, such as to pass its `id` to a workflow or an alert route. Any valid API key can read status pages; no specific scope is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a status page by name, as it was created in the dashboard.
data "incident_status_page" "public" {
  name = "Our public status page"
}

# Or by ID, taken from the dashboard URL or the ListStatusPages endpoint.
data "incident_status_page" "customer" {
  id = "01FCNDV6P870EA6S7TK1DSYDG0"
}

output "public_status_page_url" {
  value = data.incident_status_page.public.public_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique ID of this status page
- `name` (String) The title of this status page. Names aren't unique, so a lookup fails if more than one status page matches.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of this status page. Null when the page has none.
- `public_url` (String) The public URL of this status page. Null when the page has no public URL yet.
